title: Sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='rice' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8e4d8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- nori outer ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='32' ry='30' fill='#2f5a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='32' ry='30' fill='none' stroke='#4a8a72' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='24' fill='url(#rice)'/>
  <!-- rice grain texture -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='44' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='31' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='37' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='50' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='63' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='71' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='68' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='57' r='2' fill='#d8d2c0'/>
  <!-- salmon filling -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#f57a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='14' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#ffa880' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- salmon stripes -->
  <path d='M40 47 Q50 43 60 47' fill='none' stroke='#ffb894' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 55 Q50 51 60 55' fill='none' stroke='#ffb894' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cucumber accent -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='6' ry='5.5' fill='#6fc46a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='6' ry='5.5' fill='none' stroke='#a8e29e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cute face on rice rim -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='62' r='2.4' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='62' r='2.4' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='61.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='61.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M46 66.5 Q50 69.5 54 66.5' fill='none' stroke='#3a2a4a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='1.8' fill='#ffb0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='66' r='1.8' fill='#ffb0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
